$comment: Merge scripts and devDependencies into the root package.json. Versions verified 2026-10-03 for Expo SDK 57 (re-verify with the commands in references/jest-config.md). Install with npm install --save-dev --save-exact; never ^ or ~. Companions: @testing-library/react-native 14.0.1 needs test-renderer 1.2.0 (the React 19.2 line; 1.3.0 targets React 19.3), so install the two in one command. Keep test:golden while the app depends on Skia or has any *.golden.test.ts (the golden project is in every app); keep test:sim and babel-jest only with simulations. Never add react-test-renderer (React 19 deprecates it; RNTL 14 uses test-renderer). When multi-package, also add overridesWhenMultiPackage to the root package.json as "overrides", equal to the app workspace's exact react and react-native.
